what: Fixed header — scrolling down more than 5px at once slides it off the top of the screen (top −100%) over .6s ease, scrolling up more than 5px brings it back with a background laid down (the page using it shrinks the height at this point, e.g. 88 → 80px), and at the very top it returns to its initial form (no background). look: side is for a separately floating burger button — when hiding it moves aside 20px to the right and fades out in .3s

options.threshold: Minimum scroll (px) to count as a direction change, default 5
options.dur: Duration (sec) of hiding and returning, default .6 (look: side .3)
options.look: side: Floating button on its own — transparent instead of top, 20px from the right
options.--fx-bg: Backdrop laid down when hiding or returning, default --kf-bg
options..fx-ud-back: Returned-state marker — reducing height and text lines is left to the consumer’s css

from.where: shared.css .np-head (header row 88 → 80px on return) · .np-burger (phone burger button, look: side)
